resources.string: Keeps the EZZY bar reachable from other apps.
Tap the bubble for your vault and To Do, or add a task right here.
EZZY needs the \"Display over other apps\" permission to show the floating bar.
Draws the user\'s own floating shortcut bar over other apps so saved details can be copied without leaving the current app.
Keeps your paired Chrome browser in sync over your own Wi-Fi.
Your paired Chrome syncs while both are on the same Wi-Fi.
Keeps an end-to-end encrypted link on the local Wi-Fi open so the user\'s own paired Chrome extension can view and edit their vault.
Reminders for tasks you set a time on, with Done and Snooze.
Alarms you set in EZZY. Rings with sound until you answer it.
